contactBox.title: Still Have Questions?
contactBox.description: We're here to help! Reach out to our friendly team for any more information.

questions.q: What services do you offer for pets?
questions.a: We offer a wide range of services including pet grooming, veterinary consultations, daycare, walking, sitting, and nutrition guidance — all designed to keep your pets happy and healthy.

questions.q: Are your staff trained and certified?
questions.a: Yes, our team consists of experienced and certified professionals who are passionate about providing the best pet care.

questions.q: How do I book an appointment?
questions.a: You can easily book an appointment through our website or by giving us a call on our toll-free number.

questions.q: Do you offer emergency pet care?
questions.a: Yes, we provide round-the-clock emergency support for all our registered pet parents.
We currently serve the greater metropolitan area, and are constantly expanding our reach to help more pets.

questions.q: How do you ensure pet safety?
questions.a: Safety is our top priority. All our facilities are highly secure, and pets are always supervised by trained professionals.

questions.q: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.a: We accept all major credit cards, UPI, and cash payments for your convenience.

privacyPolicy.intro: Welcome to PawCare's Privacy Policy. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you as to how we look after your personal data when you visit our website.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you which we have grouped together as follows: Identity Data, Contact Data, Financial Data, Transaction Data, Technical Data, Profile Data, Usage Data, and Marketing and Communications Data.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we will use your personal data in the following circumstances: Where we need to perform the contract we are about to enter into or have entered into with you, or where it is necessary for our legitimate interests.

sections.title: 3. Data Security
sections.content: We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered or disclosed.

sections.title: 4. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at hello@pawcare.com.

terms.intro: Welcome to PawCare. By accessing or using our website and services, you agree to be bound by the following Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use our website or services.

sections.title: 1. Use of Our Website
sections.content: You agree to use this website only for lawful purposes and in a way that does not infringe the rights of, restrict, or inhibit anyone else's use and enjoyment of the site. You must not misuse our site by introducing viruses or attempting to gain unauthorized access.

sections.title: 2. Services
sections.content: PawCare provides pet care and related services as described on our website. We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any service at any time without prior notice.

sections.title: 3. Appointments and Cancellations
sections.content: Appointments can be booked through our website or by contacting us directly. We request you to inform us in advance if you need to reschedule or cancel an appointment. Missed appointments without prior notice may be subject to a cancellation charge.

sections.title: 4. User Responsibilities
sections.content: You are responsible for providing accurate information when using our services. You agree not to hold PawCare liable for any issues arising from incorrect or incomplete information provided by you.

sections.title: 5. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All content on this website, including text, images, logos, and designs, is the property of PawCare and is protected by applicable copyright and trademark laws. You may not use any content without our prior written permission.

sections.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: PawCare shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising out of the use of our website or services. Our total liability, if any, shall be limited to the amount paid for the service.

sections.title: 7. Changes to These Terms
sections.content: We may update these Terms and Conditions from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with the updated effective date. Your continued use of our website and services constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.title: 8. Governing Law
sections.content: These Terms and Conditions shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Bangalore, Karnataka.

refundPolicy.intro: Thank you for choosing PawCare. We understand that plans can change, and we strive to make our cancellation and refund processes as simple and transparent as possible.

sections.title: 1. Cancellation of Appointments
sections.content: If you need to cancel or reschedule an appointment, we kindly ask that you provide us with at least 24 hours notice. Cancellations made within 24 hours of the appointment time may be subject to a cancellation fee.

sections.title: 2. Refund Eligibility
sections.content: Refunds are issued for services paid in advance if the cancellation is made within the acceptable timeframe. Refunds will not be provided for services that have already been rendered.

sections.title: 3. Processing Refunds
sections.content: Approved refunds will be processed and credited back to the original method of payment within 5-7 business days.

sections.title: 4. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions about our Cancellation & Refund Policy, please contact us at hello@pawcare.com.

cookiePolicy.intro: At PawCare, we believe in being clear and open about how we collect and use data related to you. This Cookie Policy provides detailed information about how and when we use cookies on our website.

sections.title: 1. What are cookies?
sections.content: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device by websites that you visit. They are widely used in order to make websites work, or work more efficiently, as well as to provide information to the owners of the site.

sections.title: 2. How we use cookies
sections.content: We use cookies for the following purposes: Essential cookies (required for operation), Analytical/performance cookies (to count visitors and see how they move around), and Functionality cookies (to recognize you when you return).

sections.title: 3. Managing cookies
sections.content: Most web browsers allow some control of most cookies through the browser settings. To find out more about cookies, including how to see what cookies have been set, visit www.aboutcookies.org or www.allaboutcookies.org.

sections.title: 4. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions about our Cookie Policy, please contact us at hello@pawcare.com.
